ctx.x: Yes. And we're beginning to attract people. Eddie Condon gives us a show on television, Pee Wee and Art's Back Room, gives us George Wattley gives us, like, a quick two-number shot. Well, we're getting known, and the joint is beginning to fill up. We're getting a $30 a week draw, $35. Pee Wee never got too much because I stopped drinking then, and Pee Wee didn't. So Pee Wee's money always went for the booze, and my money was going to support the family. And we'd moved out of the town a little bit. We had some…
